name: Ikemiya Ayaka
source:
Hometown: Tokyo downtown
Likes: Everything
Dislikes: Nothing
Favorite things: Eating

A third-year girl who is the director of the dorms. Ayaka is a bright and kind, ojou-sama like girl who loves teasing her friends and is surprisingly powerful. She is always smiling and loves food to the point where she's considered a glutton.
